name: Physician's Touch
description: Your Hand of Harm and Hand of Healing are further enhanced. Hand of Harm - when you use Hand of Harm on a creature, you can subject that creature to the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn. Hand of Healing - when you use Hand of Healing, you can also end one of the following conditions on the creature you heal: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.

review.notes: authored from PHB 2024, mechanic not yet wired to activities
